description: Implementation of the PageRank algorithm in Apache Spark's GraphX library, including fixed-iteration, convergence-based, and personalized PageRank methods.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs PageRank for a fixed number of iterations, returning a graph with PageRank as vertex attributes.

methods.name: runUpdate
methods.description: Performs a single update step of the PageRank algorithm.

methods.name: runWithOptions
methods.description: Runs PageRank with additional options, including personalization and normalization.

methods.name: runWithOptionsWithPreviousPageRank
methods.description: Continues PageRank iterations from a previous PageRank graph.

methods.name: runParallelPersonalizedPageRank
methods.description: Computes personalized PageRank for multiple sources in parallel.

methods.name: runUntilConvergence
methods.description: Runs a dynamic PageRank until convergence based on a tolerance.

methods.name: runUntilConvergenceWithOptions
methods.description: Runs a dynamic PageRank with options until convergence.

methods.name: normalizeRankSum
methods.description: Normalizes the sum of PageRank scores to account for sinks or for personalization.
